featured_reviews.name: Nithin M Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Google Review # 000458

Hitech Diagnostic Centre charges a very reasonable fee for the services that they offer compared to the other rivals in the market. We visited this centre many times for CT Scan. The service was not bad at all, and it was not very good either. But the point is that you visit such centres to get the tests done, get the reports accurate and go back to the doctor. This aspect is taken care. Reports come in fast. Appointments are given timely. Wait time is usually depending on the queue ahead of you.

They do accept card payments, and that too without any “additional 2% charge” which many reputed centres, hospitals and clinics also charge in Mira Road. The centre is not very hygiene and you can sense or feel dust around everywhere. The crowd that flocks here also does not mind it. And everybody is more focussed to get the tests done at more cheaper rates. You can hear patients shouting for discounts and calling people who are connected to the centre in some way or other to get a 10-20% off.

The receptionists know their job and will interact with you on need-base only. Rest of the time, enjoying social media is the norm for them and even for the patients. Pharma industry is here to rule and till the time you keep prioritising your health and life over and above everything, they will continue to do so.

Date of Experience # Nov 2025.

featured_reviews.name: Jaimin Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: These people here take the payments of all the procedures in advance, whether the procedures take place or not, and in cases where any of the procedures is not performed, they do not refund that specific amount. They give all the types of excuses and reasons which do not make sense, and just do whatever they like, illegally. There's no use of discounts when these people grab money in such a manner. Please do not go here, they are an irresponsible and a fraudulent group of people. A hugely money mongering and fraudulent place it is. The staff person of the center added the amount of Doctor's Certificate in the bill and charged the amount before providing the service. When I asked why was it added and it should be removed, they said that if the service won't be used, they will refund the amount of Rs. 1500 that they had charged. Later, the attending doctor asked to take the Fitness Certificate from another doctor and not the center's appointed doctor. The illness went on for 2 more months, so we were not able to approach them for our refund. At last when we asked for the refund, they denied it saying we were late in asking for it and started giving illogical and unreasonable excuses for not refunding the amount. They first said that the staff is changed, then said that they don't have the records, then said that the doctor isn't available, etc. but they never intended or tried to understand and refund the amount of Rs. 1500. We tried for more than 15 days, but they are not responding assertively at all now. Kindly help with the issue and please enable us get the refund.

featured_reviews.name: Yogesh Girase
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a very bad experience during our anomaly (5-month pregnancy) scan at Swasth Diagnostic Centre.
The scan was done too quickly, and they didn’t call my husband inside to review or explain the results.
After receiving the report, we noticed that the scan images were of very poor quality — blurry and unclear — especially compared to those from other diagnostic centres where we’ve had much better experiences.

The staff also did not seem as professional or attentive.
Overall, we do not recommend visiting this centre for pregnancy scans.

featured_reviews.name: Suraaj Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the hospital for blood donation with a genuine intention to help others. During the screening, I was told that my hemoglobin level was low. However, after further tests, everything came out normal and there was no health issue found.

I feel the staff handling the blood donation process need better training and proper knowledge. Hiring inexperienced staff without enough medical understanding can create unnecessary fear and confusion for donors. Because of this, people who come forward for a good cause may feel discouraged from donating blood again.

I hope the hospital management improves staff training and ensures accurate guidance is given to donors in the future.

They delayed the payment for a long time. When I was making the payment, I was given a cash payment. There is no change for 500 rs in such a big blood bank. They made me check it from the shop next door. The staff is very terrible in such an emergency.

Very bad service

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Limaye
featured_reviews.review_text: They are a shame on humanity. They take a non refundable deposit of ₹450 , do not give receipt, no terms clearly explained. My dad was being operated upon in SUVARNA Hospital Borivali west and we had requested for reservation of blood on 19.03.2026. Fortunately we did not need blood on 20.03 and 21.03 but we were in need of blood unit for 22.03.2026.When we called them, they said it is over 24 hours so you will have to pay deposit again . Basically a con game to get ₹450 as advance and refuse to accept it later ( within 48 hours). This is absolute inhuman behaviour from the blood bank. They will have a curse of a million people if they continue to operate with such foolish money mindset with no respect to customer inconvenience and do not bother to give any receipts or  explain these terms before making reservation. They should be closed down on unethical business practices.
